skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general concepts and history of internal control.
Identify and explain the components that make up internal control.
Evaluate risks within business processes and apply appropriate controls.
Apply internal control principles to various business processes such as procurement, sales, payroll, fixed assets, and cash management.
Implement internal controls in an IT environment.
Develop critical thinking skills to assess and critique the application of internal controls.
Think systematically about internal control issues and solve problems effectively.
Work independently on internal control issues.
Collaborate effectively in teams to address internal control challenges.
Adapt to working environments with integrated operations.
Develop basic computer skills using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches in organizing internal control.
